title: Finite evaluation of the ordinary reduction and pullback mate
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, schemes X,Y, a morphism f:X→Y and n≥0. Supply an OrdinaryLimitModel a as in [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge]. Write ρX,ρY for pullbackTensorReductionEvaluation, θ for pullbackTensorSequenceInverseEvaluation, F for completed ordinary pullback, EvX/EvY for finite sequence evaluation and L for level pullback. For every completed ordinary module M on Y, ρX_(F M) followed by EvX(a.reductionPull(f)_M) and θ⁻¹_(ordinaryReduction(Y)(M)) equals ordinaryFiniteScalarPull(f,n)_M followed by L(ρY_M). On every cochain complex P, the degreewise equation gives EvXcx(a.reductionPullComplex(f,P)) followed by θcx⁻¹_(ordinaryReduction(Y)cx(P)) and Lcx(ρYcx⁻¹_P), equal to ρXcx⁻¹_(Fcx(P)) followed by ordinaryFiniteScalarPullComplex(f,n,P).

source.place: The scalar/pullback comparison on a flat-term K-flat representative in the finite-evaluation argument; Stacks Tags 07A6, 06YY and 0D6E.

proof.text: Transpose the ordinary finite square through the completed geometric adjunction and the finite scalar adjunction. The defining unit equations of reductionPull, reductionEvaluation and inverseEvaluation reduce the equality to the square of limit projections and scalar restriction/direct image. The OrdinaryLimitModel.projections equation and finiteScalarRestrictionDirect_sections prove it sectionwise. Naturality of the scalar unit finishes the transposed equation. Injectivity gives the ordinary square. Apply this square in each degree, cancel the reduction-evaluation isomorphism, and use functoriality to prove the cochain form.

theorem integralReductionPullOrdinaryComplex (a : OrdinaryLimitModel l E)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ) :
    ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E X n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        (a.reductionPullComplex l E f P) ≫
      (pullbackTensorInverseEvaluationComplex l E f n).inv.app
        (((pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
      ((integralOperationsLevelPullback l E f n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        ((pullbackTensorReductionEvaluationComplex l E Y n).inv.app P) =
    (pullbackTensorReductionEvaluationComplex l E X n).inv.app
        (((integralOrdinaryPull l E f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
      ordinaryFiniteScalarPullComplex l E f n P
